home.title: fsg – file structure generator
home.description: fsg prints clean project trees that respect .gitignore and keeps them current in your README – with a check for CI and a commit hook that does it for you.

installation.title: Installation
installation.text: Install with uv or pipx, or run it once with uvx.

usage.title: Usage
usage.text: Every option, filter and exit code of the command line.

markers.title: Markers & sections
markers.text: Keep one or several trees inside your README up to date.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.text: CI checks, pre-commit, monorepos and more, ready to copy.

example.title: Two markers, one command
example.text: Put the markers where the tree belongs and run fsg --update README.md. Options in the start marker apply to that tree only, and comments next to an entry survive every update.

gitignore.title: Respects .gitignore
gitignore.text: Inside a git repository only files git tracks or would track are listed. Outside, build and tool directories like .venv, node_modules or target are skipped.

current.title: Never out of date
current.text: --update rewrites the marked block, --check fails CI when it is outdated and --setup-hook runs the update on every commit.

dependencies.title: No dependencies
dependencies.text: Pure Python 3.11+, MIT licensed. Runs with uvx on Linux, macOS and Windows without installing anything else.

help.title: Found a bug or missing an option?
help.text: Open an issue on GitHub. Pull requests are welcome, translations of these docs too.
